name: google_custom_search
description: Searches the web via Google's Custom Search JSON API and returns the top matching links with titles and snippets.

num.description: Number of results to return (1-10, default 5)

api_key.description: Google Cloud API key. Reads GOOGLE_CSE_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY) if omitted.

cx.description: Programmable Search Engine ID. Reads GOOGLE_CSE_ID if omitted.
